sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Wind Release, Fire Release, Clash

system.description:
You slam the ground causing flames to sweep out in all directions originating from you, attempting to incinerate everything near you.

Select a corner of the space you are currently occupying, as the flames expand outwards in a 30-foor radius, centered on this point. All creatures, excluding you, within the radius must make a Constitution saving throw, taking On a failed save, they take 6d8 Fire damage and gain 2 ranks of Immolated or half as much damage on a success.

Scorch. By spending 3 Scorch Charges, you can focus the hellfire you conjure onto a single creature. Select one creature in this jutsu’s radius and conjure all of the murderous flame onto them as it erupts from other them. They make their saving throw at disadvantage. If they fail their saving throw by 5 or more, they instead gain 4 ranks of Immolated.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, and the radius by +10 feet.
